RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot be reliably estimated from these facts.

An all-male panel raises a reasonable question about the selection process, but does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Your qualifications warrant asking how candidates were assessed; the announcement may omit his relevant experience, and higher qualifications do not automatically mean a stronger fit.

Follow up in writing requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the applicable recruitment and panel-composition policies. You can neutrally flag the panel’s composition alongside these questions without alleging discrimination.

Two weeks’ silence is not itself evidence of bias. Keep records and check local complaint deadlines now—waiting for an explanation may not pause them. Legal significance depends on your jurisdiction.
